about: Segmentation checkpoints a processing job can use. Files live in this folder and are never committed. Every model must be a U-Net / ResNet34 with 6 classes and 8-bit RGB input scaled by 1/255.

models.name: Village model (SVAMITVA)
models.trained_on: SVAMITVA drone orthoimagery of rural villages

models.name: Urban model (UAVPal, Bhopal)
models.trained_on: Fine-tuned on UAVPal drone imagery of Bhopal, trained to keep touching buildings apart
